6 days | Tarangire, Serengeti and Ngorongoro

Package overview

Arusha, Tarangire’s elephants and baobabs, two nights in the Serengeti and a crater descent. We meet you in Arusha, or connect you from Nairobi.

A first Tanzania safari, timed to where the herds are. Highlights: Tarangire elephants, Serengeti game drive, Ngorongoro Crater.

Route Arusha → Tarangire → Serengeti → Ngorongoro → Arusha

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Arrive Arusha

A quiet arrival day. Overnight in Arusha. Ask us to book the Nairobi connection if you are combining countries.

Accommodation: Arusha

02Day 2 | Tarangire

Full day among elephants and baobabs. Overnight at Tarangire or on the way to Karatu.

Accommodation: Tarangire

03Day 3 | Into the Serengeti

Drive via the Ngorongoro highlands, with a viewpoint stop, and an afternoon game drive. Where you sleep depends on the month and the herds.

Accommodation: Serengeti

04Day 4 | Serengeti

A full day on the plains. In January and February that usually means the southern short grass. From July it is often the north or the western corridor.

Accommodation: Serengeti

05Day 5 | Serengeti to Ngorongoro

Morning drive, then up to the crater rim.

Accommodation: Ngorongoro

06Day 6 | Crater and departure

A morning on the crater floor, then back to Arusha.

Accommodation: Departure

Where you sleep

Budget is a permanent tent or a simple lodge. Mid-range is an en-suite lodge or tented camp. Luxury is a smaller camp and, where it helps, a flight between parks. The camp names are written on your quote.

What's included

  • Accommodation on the plan we send you
  • Meals noted in the day-by-day itinerary
  • A private 4x4 with a pop-up roof and an English-speaking guide
  • Park and conservancy fees for the places on the itinerary
  • Arrival and departure transfers in the city where the trip starts
  • Bottled drinking water in the vehicle

What's excluded

  • International flights
  • Visas, vaccinations and travel insurance
  • Gorilla and chimpanzee permits, unless your quote includes them
  • Tips, laundry, premium drinks and personal purchases
  • Balloon flights, extra activities and community visits
